answer: A new identity must burn a ferrous bond into the canyon treasury before it can trade, and the protocol traces the bond's funding source: the burn for the k-th identity funded from the same source is k squared times the base fee, so one identity costs one unit but ten cost 385 units in total, with no refund and no sharing, since each burn is locked to a single key. The bond must also sit untouched through one full tide cycle before activation, so a burst of clones cannot activate together; an operator running n fakes pays a quadratic, non-poolable burn plus n separate waiting periods.
